hero.title: A Turnkey Tabuk Hills Sales Center in 48 Hours
hero.body: Manzili had the Tabuk Hills sales center running in 48 hours, with pre-built showroom hardware, a WebGL twin of the masterplan and sales playbooks for the local team.

sidebar: Tabuk Hills · NHC destination masterplan · 2,237,000+ m² · 4,600+ residential units
WebGL masterplan twin · Plug-and-play sales center hardware · Local sales team training

challenge.title: Running a High-Volume Sales Center Far From Riyadh
challenge.body: A high-volume off-plan sales center in Tabuk needed reliable hardware that didn't depend on scarce local AV specialists.

cards.title: Few Specialist Technicians
cards.body: Regional cities have few AV and GPU specialists, so any hardware fault risks long showroom downtime.

cards.title: Doubts About Off-Plan Homes
cards.body: Buyers used to inspecting finished homes hesitated to commit to 4,600+ unbuilt units without seeing them.

cards.title: New Sales Teams
cards.body: Newly hired consultants struggled to explain infrastructure timelines and relied on handing out brochures.

solution.title: A Turnkey Remote Sales Setup for Tabuk Hills
solution.body: Manzili delivered a browser-based WebGL masterplan, pre-configured showroom hardware racks and on-site coaching tailored to local buyers.

blocks.label: Pillar 01 · Digital Twin
blocks.title: Browser-Based Masterplan Twin
blocks.body: A 2.2M+ m² WebGL model of all 4,600+ homes, parks, schools and commercial facilities, running smoothly at 60 FPS on every device.

features.title: Accurate Terrain
features.body: Real elevation contours of the Tabuk plateau

features.title: Amenity Distances
features.body: Walking and driving times to schools and clinics

features.title: Works in Any Browser
features.body: No installs for buyers or consultants

blocks.label: Pillar 03 · Showroom Hardware
blocks.title: Pre-Built Showroom Hardware
blocks.body: Touch tables and presenter consoles shipped pre-configured in flight racks, with remote health monitoring that cuts the need for on-site technician visits.

features.title: Remote Diagnostics
features.body: Temperature and GPU load flagged to Riyadh engineers

blocks.label: Pillar 04 · Sales Enablement
blocks.title: Sales Team Certification
blocks.body: Hands-on coaching taught Tabuk consultants to guide first-time off-plan buyers through the 3D twin step by step.

features.title: Reservation Routine
features.body: Timed unit holds before interest fades
